korea.title: Korea / DPRK / Yellow Sea
korea.subtitle: DPRK provocations, Korean memory knock-ons, Pacific defense pull

secondOrderEffects: DPRK launches usually tighten Korean defense procurement and US Pacific posture rather than triggering kinetic action, so defense beats consumer-tech beta.
Memory and foundry concentration in Korea makes Samsung and SK Hynix the cleanest single-name Korea-binary expressions; the EWY country ETF is a faster proxy than ADRs.
Risk-off flows into USD and away from KRW often outlast the immediate headline cycle, lifting dollar-strength expressions even after launch news fades.
